author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.15 shipped: HVAC zones establish on live rooms only; coverage self-check stops false unit-mismatch alarms
summary: HVAC zones establish on live rooms only; coverage self-check stops false unit-mismatch alarms
why: Operator ruled 2026-09-17 and again 2026-09-26 that a failed room counts toward nothing and acts as if not defined in URA; round 5 had reverted to all(zone.rooms), so a single failed room silently pinned its zone to conditioning empty space forever. Establishment is now computed over live rooms, with a reloading room blocking outright so a restart cannot cold-retreat a zone. Coverage: the midnight re-anchor assumption was measured false over 10 days of recorder history, so the excuse window was widened and the unproven unit-mismatch diagnosis removed.
implications: Shipped HVAC-DEGRADED-ROOM-TRIPWIRE-1, COVERAGE-RATING-FALSE-ANOMALOUS-1 at v5.103.15; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.15.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If any zone shows excluded_rooms non-empty or a transient_room_hold ledger row appears outside a restart, re-examine classification; if coverage warns out-of-bounds outside the re-anchor window, re-probe the recorder.

refs.release_notes: HVAC-DEGRADED-ROOM-TRIPWIRE-1: a disabled/failing/removed room no longer blocks its HVAC zone from retreating; a reloading room blocks establishment and holds the occupancy-only switch back to home/sleep for that tick; one WARN+NM per excluded room; zone status diagnostics; latent UnboundLocalError with Zone Intelligence off fixed. COVERAGE-RATING-FALSE-ANOMALOUS-1: negative coverage delta excused across the local-midnight re-anchor; warning no longer asserts unit mismatch. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.15.md.
